scripts/binary_native_payload.py

Python · Tier B

Compile a verified runtime file table into platform-native launch artifacts.

Usage

Called by the native builder after runtime and dependency validation.

Inputs

Staged image, dedicated work/output paths, build metadata and configuration.

Side effects

Writes runtime manifests, raw payload and C++ tables; invokes CMake; normalizes image permissions and assembles an executable or macOS bundle.

Cleanup

Build subprocesses complete synchronously; the caller removes staging files.

@see scripts/native_binary_builder.py

@see packaging/native_launcher/CMakeLists.txt
